There was a time in my life when I volunteered on the ambulance with two local EMS stations in Pennsylvania where I lived. I was a trained EMT and equipped to help a hurting person.

During my times of duty, I was prepared to run at a moment’s notice. I had no idea when my ever-present pager would sound an alarm. At night, I would sleep fully dressed in my EMT garb.
